title: Moscow Keepers
wikitext:
[[File:Logo_mk.JPG|thumb|[MK] Quake clan]] During the heyday of Quake, many clans were created, playing Quake on the Internet. The servers were always filled with players. Quake became a religion. But time passes, the Quake movement gradually dies. And the remaining players - those who remain faithful to Quake, unite again.
This was the case with the [[Moscow Quake Forces]] and [[KGB]] clans. At first, they had a large number of players, but gradually almost all of them became "dead souls". And then the remaining best players of these clans united under a new name: MOSCOW KEEPERS.
The MOSCOW KEEPERS clan was formed in July 1998 by players of the MQF clan: Gleb, Wonavi, GyperLexa and the KGB clan: RuLeZzZ and RiPpEr. After some time, AlexKiller, Chikatilo and RL from the PV clan joined them.
The name was chosen for a long time. First, they came up with the abbreviation MK, then, at the suggestion of WoNAvI, the abbreviation MOSCOW KEEPERS was adopted, which we understand as "Keepers".
